nina: opened PR to update SDK snippets for streaming+pagination across py/ts/go. included a small 'checkpoint' helper to persist last page token during retries. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/507

raj: can you paste the Python async iterator example? want to verify we don't restart from page1 on retry.

nina: sure:

nina: ```python
# async iterator with checkpoint-preserve on transient failures
from redwood import AsyncClient
from redwood.docs_utils import resume_pages_async

client = AsyncClient()
checkpoint = None
async for page in resume_pages_async(lambda token: client.stream_pages(token), checkpoint):
    handle(page)
    checkpoint = page.next_token
```

emily: added a small note to explain that checkpoint is kept in-memory by default; mention persistence to redis for cross-process resume. also flagged a broken internal link to /docs/streams which should be /docs/reference/streaming.
